title: Fresh Berry Medley
description: A colorful mix of strawberries, blueberries, blackberries, and raspberries. Perfect for snacking, topping on yogurt, or adding a burst of antioxidants to your morning smoothie.

title: Tropical Fruit Platter
description: An exotic assortment of pineapple, mango, papaya, and kiwi, delivering a taste of the tropics with each bite. Refreshing, sweet, and full of vitamin C and A.

title: Citrus Delight
description: A zesty mix of oranges, grapefruits, lemons, and limes, perfect for a refreshing snack or for adding zest to dishes. Packed with vitamin C and antioxidants.

title: Melon Medley
description: A hydrating mix of watermelon, cantaloupe, and honeydew, known for their juicy, subtly sweet flavors. Perfect for summer or as a cooling snack.

title: Orchard Fresh Apples and Pears
description: A crisp selection of apples and pears, ideal for snacking, baking, or adding crunch to salads. Rich in fiber, vitamin C, and heart-healthy nutrients.

title: Stone Fruit Sampler
description: A juicy variety of peaches, plums, nectarines, and cherries, perfect for summertime treats or baking. Packed with fiber and antioxidants for overall wellness.

title: Grapes and Berry Bounty
description: A perfect mix of green and red grapes with assorted berries, ideal for picnics, charcuterie boards, or a quick sweet snack. Full of antioxidants and vitamins.

title: Exotic Fruit Basket
description: An adventurous mix of dragon fruit, lychee, passionfruit, and starfruit. A treat for those looking to try unique textures and flavors from around the world.

title: Mixed Berry and Citrus Salad
description: A refreshing salad made of blueberries, strawberries, and oranges, tossed with a hint of mint. Perfect as a light dessert or healthy snack.

title: Autumn Harvest Assortment
description: A seasonal mix of apples, pears, pomegranates, and cranberries, ideal for autumn snacking or festive gatherings. High in fiber and antioxidants, with a touch of seasonal spice.
